Solid programming fundamentals and comfort moving between application code and AI/model code. Familiarity with the ecosystem — e.g. LLM APIs and frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, vector databases, and orchestration/streaming tools like Kafka or Airflow. Interest in agentic systems, evaluation and guardrails for LLMs, or applied problems like anomaly detection and event correlation. Contributions to open-source projects. This position demands a unique blend of product management acumen, financial domain expertise, technical depth, and the ability to bridge Finance, IT, and Engineering teams. You will also serve as an early adopter and champion of AI-powered tools and automation to continuously improve the efficiency and intelligence of billing and revenue operations. Requirements Translation & Execution: Transform high-level business and finance objectives into clear, actionable system requirements that guide design and implementation phases with precision. Ensure requirements account for revenue accounting impact, financial close timelines, and audit readiness. Zuora Subject Matter Expert (SME): Serve as the organization's primary authority on Zuora Billing and Zuora Revenue (RevPro) — including product architecture, data models, custom objects, workflow configurations, rule sets, and integration points within the broader O2R ecosystem (Salesforce CPQ, NetSuite ERP). Stay current on Zuora roadmap releases and proactively assess impact to existing configurations. Finance & Revenue Operations Partnership: Act as the key systems partner to Finance, Revenue Accounting, and Revenue Operations teams. Develop deep understanding of how billing system configurations drive financial outcomes, including revenue recognition schedules, contract modifications, standalone selling prices (SSPs), and period-end close processes. System Design & Scalability: Partner with engineering and technical architects to ensure system designs are scalable, maintainable, and compliant with security and regulatory standards. Architect solutions that support business growth, new pricing models, and evolving revenue recognition requirements. AI-Driven Process Innovation: Identify and champion opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation to streamline billing operations, reduce manual effort, and workflow automation. Use generative AI tools to accelerate requirements documentation, testing, and knowledge management. Agile Development Leadership: Lead agile delivery (Scrum/Kanban), including backlog prioritization, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives to drive continuous improvement and velocity. System Deployment & Quality Assurance: Oversee configuration changes, manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and ensure successful deployment of new features across Zuora Billing and Zuora Revenue platforms. Define and maintain test scripts that validate financial accuracy and compliance. Change Management & User Adoption: Lead change management initiatives — including developing training materials, conducting user training sessions, and driving adoption of new features and processes. Communicate the 'why' behind system changes to Finance and Operations stakeholders to ensure buy-in and smooth transitions. SOX Compliance & Controls: Maintain and document SOX controls for billing and revenue systems, ensuring adherence to internal control frameworks and supporting audit requirements. Partner with Internal Audit to address control gaps and maintain a robust compliance posture. Zuora Expertise (Mandatory): Deep, hands-on experience configuring and implementing Zuora Billing and Zuora Revenue (RevPro), including subscription products, rate plans, discount schedules, billing rules, revenue recognition rules, performance obligations, and custom objects. Proven ability to architect end-to-end billing and revenue solutions, not just administer them. Finance & Revenue Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of SaaS subscription financial models and revenue metrics including ARR, MRR, NRR, churn, and gross retention. Deep knowledge of revenue recognition under ASC 606/IFRS 15, including contract modifications, variable consideration, standalone selling prices (SSPs), and deferred/unbilled revenue accounting. Ability to partner effectively with Revenue Accounting, FP&A, and RevOps teams. O2R Proficiency: Comprehensive understanding of the subscription lifecycle: Quote-to-Order, Order-to-Cash, Order-to-Revenue, Invoicing, Payment Processing, and Revenue Accounting — and how each stage affects financial reporting and compliance. Technical Skills: Proficiency with relational databases, SQL/ZOQL queries for data analysis and reconciliation, and API-based system integration. Collaboration: Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with proven ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams spanning Finance, IT, and Engineering. Ability to translate complex technical concepts for finance audiences, and vice versa.   Preferred Qualifications Zuora Certification: Zuora Certified Administrator or Zuora Certified Revenue Analyst/Developer. AI/ML Application in Finance Systems: Experience evaluating or implementing AI-driven enhancements to billing or revenue workflows — such as intelligent invoice generation, automated revenue allocation, predictive churn analysis, or natural language querying of financial data. Public Company Experience: Experience at a publicly traded company with direct ownership of SOX controls, audit support, and finance systems compliance processes. Revenue Intelligence Platforms: Familiarity with revenue intelligence or analytics tools (e.g., Clari, Gong, Salesforce Revenue Cloud) and how they integrate with core billing and revenue systems.
